profile.headline: Senior AI Product Buider at Evernorth Health Services
profile.summary: Student at Illinois State University, working toward a B.S. in computer science planning on graduating in fall of 2022. I pride myself on my passion, teamwork and ambition. I have learned to value readable code, debugging, communication and having diverse knowledge in coding language and concepts. C and Java are programming languages of choice and I’m familiar with Python, c++, JavaScript and html. I have work experience with fork and GitHub.

positions.title: Senior AI Product Buider
positions.description: Providing custom software applications and automations in the most complex business environments!

positions.title: Senior Product AI/Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Product AI/Software Engineer for Booz Allen Hamilton's - Vellox Agentic Product Suite.

Development focused on the underlying agent harness for Vellox Agentic Product Suite.

positions.title: AI Platform Engineer
positions.description:
FAST Enterprise core product development, focused leading design and development of AI/ML support in FAST Enterprises COTS base software application.

Generative AI Large Language Models Service:
 - Developed a platform to load, run and manage open sourced models with ONNX Runtime GenAI. This platform supports internal system and external (via MCP) tool calling. Supports load
 - Developed framework for rapid and visible development of agents and prompts to provide human-in-the-loop automation for business processes.
 - Developed a solution to audit all use of LLM service. Ability to view all queries made to the LLM service along with metadata, at a user specified level of granularity.
 - Manage GPU accelerated servers for demo and corporate test environments.
 - Corporate test environment supports 12 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs.
 - Support for managing model versions and variations.

Text-to-Speech: Developed platform to load, run and manage Chatterbox-Text-To-Speech-Multilingual one shot model with ONNX Runtime. Converted the official Chatterbox TTS Python library to C#, for this model to run natively in our product.

Provide New Feature Documentation for the LLM service and the agentic framework. A very important part of my role as these features have to be implemented by our forward deployed engineers and they rely on this documentation to understand how to use the features.

Agile development methodology with Kanban board for project management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led subsystem upgrade for the Illinois Department of Revenue (IDOR), implementing payment and revenue accounting processes within the state-wide tax management system.
- Worked alongside customers across technical and business teams to translate complex requirements into scalable solutions, presenting technical designs and driving product decisions in demo, definition, and development meetings.
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in a high-pressure, mission-critical environment, consistently meeting tight deadlines while working directly with clients to deliver tested and scalable solutions.
- Initiated and led a mentorship program for 32 engineers, showcasing leadership, team-building capabilities, and a proactive mindset necessary for an early-stage company.

positions.title: Assoiate Software Developer
positions.description:
Full stack development for LRS’s enterprise output management software. 
- Development for multiple products within LRS's product suite. The core product was set up as a distributed system with three services handling Model View and Controller functionalities individually. Development required network connections (message generation, formatting TCP/IP interfaces).
- Gitlab CI/CD pipeline for the LRS suite of products.
Implemented REST APIs and full-stack solutions using C, Python, and TypeScript
- Created Langer, an in-house development tool for language decode management for the LRS suite of products
- Agile Scrum development methodology.

positions.title: EOM development intern
positions.description: Software Developer for LRS's Enterprise Output Management open systems application. Projects include front and back end updates and fixes, in c, javascript, html and css.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Lead design, development and deployment of Digital marketing.
- Deployed AWS containerized hosted webpage with PostSQL database.
